messages:
Ashley: FYI - automated audit found non-default ACLs on backup bucket team-backups-prod. Some objects under tenant-245 show public-read granted. Not sure how long this has been live.

backup-bot: Automated detection at 2025-11-03T14:05:12Z - S3 ACL anomaly for s3://team-backups-prod/tenant-245/ - severity=high

Devon: acknowledged. Any recent IAM/RBAC changes for the backup agent role? @Maria (sec) did we approve anything that could allow PutObjectAcl?

Maria (sec): I approved a change ~2 weeks ago that added s3:PutObjectAcl to role service-account:backup-agent so the agent could set bucket-owner-full-control in cross-account copies. That might be the culprit. :thinking:

Samir: can we capture a sample ACL and paste it here? Quick repro with aws cli would help.

Ashley: pasted sample below from one of the objects:

```
$ aws s3api get-object-acl --bucket team-backups-prod --key tenant-245/db-snap-20251102.tar.gz
{
  "Owner": {"DisplayName": "redwood-storage", "ID": "abc123"},
  "Grants": [
    {"Grantee": {"Type": "CanonicalUser", "ID": "abc123"}, "Permission": "FULL_CONTROL"},
    {"Grantee": {"Type": "Group", "URI": "http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers"}, "Permission": "READ"}
  ]
}
```

Devon: public READ on snapshot objects. We should block uploads that set ACLs immediately.

Maria (sec): proposed emergency mitigations:
- Revoke s3:PutObjectAcl from backup-agent role (emergency policy rollback)
- Apply a deny policy on the bucket to reject uploads without SSE=CMEK and with custom ACLs
- Run inventory to list objects with non-default ACLs and remediate them
- Search CloudTrail for PutObjectAcl + GetObject events to assess exposure

Samir: also check encryption mode per object. The agent has been toggling between SSE-S3 (SSE) and SSE-KMS with our alias/backup-cmek. If some objects are SSE-S3 then KMS rotation won't touch them. We need to capture encryption metadata.

Ashley: quick deny policy I used to block insecure uploads (example):

```
# deny PutObject if request missing SSE=aws:kms or including custom ACL
aws iam create-policy --policy-name deny-insecure-uploads --policy-document '{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{
    "Effect":"Deny",
    "Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
    "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::team-backups-prod/*",
    "Condition":{
      "StringNotEquals":{"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms"},
      "Null":{"s3:x-amz-acl":"false"}
    }
  }]
}'
```

Maria (sec): good. Devon, run a CloudTrail query for PutObjectAcl events from principal arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/backup-agent and collect eventIDs/timestamps. If there are any GetObject calls by other accounts, escalate to legal and customer ops.

Devon: running CT now; will post results in ~15m.

backup-bot: Launching inventory job to scan bucket for non-default ACLs and to collect SSE metadata. ETA ~22m.

Samir: remediation plan for already-exposed objects:
1) Copy objects in-place setting --acl bucket-owner-full-control and --sse aws:kms with --sse-kms-key-id alias/backup-cmek so they are both owned and CMEK-encrypted
2) Tag objects with audit metadata: encrypted=CMEK, audit=remediated-2025-11-03
3) Rotate any pre-signed URLs and purge CDN cache if objects were cached externally

Ashley: should we notify affected tenants now or wait for CT results? I don't want to spam customers if there was no external access.

Maria (sec): notify if CT shows GetObject from principals outside account or if S3 server access logs show public GETs. Otherwise file incident package for GRC and keep customers informed per policy. I'll open incident.

Devon: CT results - found 12 PutObjectAcl calls by arn:aws:iam::999999999999:role/backup-agent between 2025-10-20 and 2025-10-22. No cross-account GetObject calls observed in that timeframe. Attaching event IDs to the incident.

Ashley: putting a hold on the backup-agent rollout, applying deny-insecure-uploads to the bucket, and kicking off remediation once inventory completes. I will post updates here.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20251103-42 created by Maria (sec) - severity P2 - assigned to eng-storage. Use channel #inc-INC-20251103 for live coordination.

Samir: post-remediation, add a CI/gate that runs ACL + SSE conformance tests for the backup-agent release pipeline to prevent future regressions.

Maria (sec): and add an alert rule to trigger on any PutObjectAcl that grants global or cross-account READ/WRITE. Also schedule an RBAC review for roles that interact with backup buckets.

backup-bot: Inventory complete - 17 objects with public-read detected. Starting remediation job.

backup-bot: remediation finished - 17 objects updated to bucket-owner-full-control, applied CMEK encryption where possible, tags set, no external GETs seen in CloudTrail. Recommend full post-incident review.

Maria (sec): drafting postmortem checklist: root cause (over-broad role grant), detection timeline, blast radius, remediation steps, follow-ups (RBAC tightening, CI gate, daily ACL scan, alerting). I'll circulate for review.

Devon: action item - enable daily inventory scan for non-default ACLs on all backup buckets and add a periodic diff report to #eng-security.

Ashley: noted. Closing thread after postmortem published. :white_check_mark:
